Glad I found such a well stocked, easy to deal with business who really seemed to go out of their way to make me happy and satisfy my needs. Thank you!

Am so happy I found this place ! Im visiting friends here. Very Nice & clean. They had stock of a product I use regularly. The lady there could not have been nicer and answered my questions. I rented a wheelchair for my husband that just had surgery . When I put it in the car I noticed it smelled like urine. I took a closer look and the handles had gunk built up in them and the wheels were full of hair wrapped around and dust. I took it back inside and they said they had just pressure washed it. This is medical equipment that should be going through severe disinfection process after each patient , not just a pressure wash. As stated before, they are very dry and not focused on the customer experience. They just refunded me my money and off I went. No real attempt at service recovery - although I wouldn’t want anything from a place with such low cleaning standards even during a pandemic.

Be VERY CAUTIOUS of there pricing, rented a vertical lift chair for a month then after a brief web search was bale to BUY a better chair for $50 more.
